scope: Original placeholder images for the local lab. The field design records identify the gameplay context.

scenes.prompt: Create ONE original, seamless-looking widescreen 2D side-scrolling RPG background illustration, approximate 16:9 crop. Scene A: the playable coastal track near a Beryl hillside domain in a French-inspired water-engineering fantasy province. Original layout: tranquil blue-green inlet with pale limestone bluffs and old terraced stonework, one tall weathered pale limestone aqueduct off center, distant white coastal town, quiet green cypresses and soft late-morning light. Distinct coordinated palette of turquoise water, warm warm-gray limestone and pine green. The lower 28% stays quiet, darker and low contrast, a consistent continuous region of muted water and cliff foot with no painted playable terrain, platforms or foreground props; the actual gameplay terrain is rendered separately. Camera horizontal side view and wide landscape. Crisp intentional pixel-art clusters in the spirit of hand-painted 2D fantasy game backdrops, medium-large color clusters and limited smooth gradients, disciplined silhouettes, gently layered distance, little random textured noise and absolutely no dithering. Large readable shapes important for compression. Fill the entire canvas, no transparency. No text, characters, enemies, logo, UI, frame, or tileset sheet. Original art and original scene geometry. No reproduction of any commercial screenshot.

Create ONE original widescreen background illustration approximate 16:9 for a 2D side-scrolling fantasy RPG. Scene B: a small limestone sluice chamber reached from a bright coast in a turquoise French-inspired water-engineering fantasy province. Original layout: shaded, room-scale pale limestone vaulted interior with an old bronze waterwheel slightly to the right and a rectangular deep turquoise spillway to the left. One distant narrow opening brings restrained warm sunlight, leaving a clearly distinguishable dark blue-green interior and limestone silhouette. Keep the lower 28% consistently subdued with a continuous muted wall and water band for independently rendered game floor and enemies. Horizontal side view, camera level. Crisp intentional pixel-art clusters, large quiet color masses, discrete shadow groups, sparse accents, careful placed detail only at the valve, wheel, and entry light. No random texture noise, grain or dithering. No painted playable foreground paths or platforms, no figures, monsters, text, logo, interface, frame or decorative foreground overlay. Fill the canvas, no transparency. Design original geometry, no reproduction of existing commercial art.
